function_signature: def compute_snr(traces: np.ndarray, intermediate_values: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray
expected_pass_rate: >= 0.95 (13 test cases in all; the main metric is task_success, scored 0 or 1 for the whole task: it is 1 only if no blocking failure occurs and every functional case passes — the registered process and performance cases are excluded from the functional set but block on failure; the pass-rate threshold on the left and the per-case pass rate are recorded as diagnostics only)
constraints: No for-loop over the N traces
input traces of shape (N, T), intermediate_values of shape (N,) with discrete values
return an SNR curve of shape (T,)
classes with fewer than 2 samples must be skipped
source: Mangard §4.3.2, the definition of SNR; Standaert-Malkin-Yung EUROCRYPT 2009
author: Zhou Wenquan
